name: Bird-Dog on Stability Ball with Dumbbell
description: A bird-dog performed with knees on a stability ball while holding a dumbbell in the extended arm. The unstable surface dramatically increases the stabilization demand throughout the spine and hip. This version builds core endurance and proprioception for unstable surface training.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Bird-Dog on Stability Ball with Dumbbell in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Bird-Dog on Stability Ball with Dumbbell.
steps: Step 1: Place knees on stability ball, hands on floor in tabletop position.
Step 2: Hold dumbbell in one hand. Stabilize on ball.
Step 3: Extend arm with dumbbell forward and opposite leg back simultaneously.
Step 4: Return and repeat without letting ball shift excessively.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Start without dumbbell to build skill
